Mac.Settings.NeedOne: Turn on at least one shortcut. Otherwise screenshots can only be taken from the menu bar icon.
Mac.Settings.PrivacyNote: Screenshots are never sent anywhere. Screeny goes online only to check for updates and when you send a report yourself.
Mac.Settings.SystemShortcut: {0} is a macOS screenshot shortcut. Turn it off in System Settings › Keyboard › Keyboard Shortcuts › Screenshots, otherwise Screeny never gets the key press.
Mac.Wizard.Intro: Allow screen recording, choose your capture shortcuts and the features you want. You can change all of this later in Settings.
Mac.Wizard.PermissionGranted: ✓ Screeny is allowed to record the screen.
Mac.Wizard.PermissionNeeded: Screeny works without the Screen Recording permission: macOS then asks you to click the screen to capture each time. Allow it to skip that step and capture straight away, like on Windows.
Mac.Wizard.PermissionNote: Turn on Screeny in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording. macOS may ask you to quit and reopen Screeny — that's fine: this window opens again so you can finish the setup.
Mac.Wizard.ShortcutNote: ⌘⇧3, ⌘⇧4 and ⌘⇧5 belong to the macOS screenshot tool. To use ⌘⇧4 in Screeny, turn it off in System Settings › Keyboard › Keyboard Shortcuts › Screenshots, then add it here.
TextMode.OcrUnavailable: Text recognition isn't available: the recognition built into macOS (Vision) couldn't start.
